title: 第21章 纵有万般不舍也总会离别第22章 我只希望你无拘无束逍遥一生
slug: 横推九世诸位女帝一直在等我
content_zh:
“无情，你在其中遇到的那些女子，你对她们可有好感？”玉鸢问道。
“这个……没有。”忆无情老实回答。
“那便好，娘亲与你父亲对你的最后一个要求便是，要你与清璃成亲。”玉鸢严肃道。
“对，师娘说得对，我也赞成。”忆绝第一个出声，表示支持。
忆无情看向冷清璃，只见她目光有些许慌乱，连忙望向四周。
忆无情清楚的看到，她的耳朵已经泛红。
“若是清璃愿意，我随时可以，若是她不愿意，那我便追求她，直到她愿意。”
忆无情的声音不大，但却十分坚定。
冷清璃对他的关照，他都记在心中，这样的女子，又有谁会拒绝呢？
过了十万载，她对自己的心意依旧如初，他的心中又如何能毫无波动呢？
他不是与他名字一般，是什么无情之人，相反，他对情有着更深的执着。
“清璃，希望你别嫌弃这孩子。”玉鸢微笑的看着冷清璃，眼中满是慈爱。
在她眼中，冷清璃早已是自己的儿媳妇，当年忆无情走后冷清璃经常来陪她说话，与她闲聊。
冷清璃对待她与忆镇承很尊重，哪怕她与忆镇承的身份只是小小的凌天宗宗主。
在她与忆镇承离世之时，冷清璃在最后一刻来到她们面前，将他们快要消散的神魂带到此地。
目的，就是为了弥补他们的遗憾，见忆无情最后一面。
“伯母……清璃愿意！”冷清璃出声了，她的声音不似之前的冰冷，反而带着一丝羞涩与紧张。
“只是……来不及了，你们……”冷清璃眼神黯淡下来。
“来不及了……难道……”忆无情看向忆镇承与玉鸢，双眼微微颤抖。
“呵呵，这不是很正常吗？我们能在见到你们三人，能在见到你们聚在一起，我们已经很满足了。”忆镇承微微一笑，笑容很是洒脱。

“是啊，我们很满足了，就是有点可惜，没能见到你们成亲，没能抱到孙子。”玉鸢也笑了起来，语气有几分遗憾。
“师尊师娘！你们不要走啊！徒儿不想又一次见证你们的离开，徒儿不想！”忆绝眼中带着泪，声嘶力竭的喊着。
“绝儿别难过……现在还能看到你，真是太好了。”玉鸢笑了笑。
“绝儿！你为何又哭了，而且这次还是在无情面前哭的，多丢人。”忆镇承严肃道：“记得小时候就与你说过，你是兄长，不能在师弟面前露出这般模样！”
“师尊……师娘……呜……”忆绝擦了擦眼泪，但还是控制不住自己。
他先后经历过太多生离死别，每次心中都有万般不舍，但却无可奈何。
他无法止住泪水，也无法控制住心中的悲切。
他不想再看到亲人的离开了，他的心早已千疮百孔，不想再亲眼目睹离别。
离别，多么伤人的两个字。
但，纵有万般不舍，也总会离别。
忆无情看着父母渐渐消散的身形，伸出手想要拉住他们，但拉到的却是一阵微风。
微风在他手中，即刻消散。
“爹……娘……”忆无情轻喃一声，无声落泪，他什么都做不了，什么都做不到。
“系统……救救他们……”忆无情默默询问系统。
【抱歉宿主……系统也无能为力。】
系统的声音也很悲切，也很无奈。
忆无情也没多说什么，系统大概也没办法，他也理解。
“无情。”忆镇承轻声唤道。
content_en:
"Qingqing, do you have a good impression of the women you met there?" Yu Yuan asked.
"This... no." Yi Qingqing answered honestly.
"That's good. The last request that your mother and your father have for you is that you marry Qingli." Yu Yuan said seriously.
"Yes, Master's wife is right, and I agree." Yi Jue was the first to speak out to express her support.
Yi Qingqing looked at Leng Qingli and saw that her eyes were a little panicked and she quickly looked around.
Yi Qingqing could clearly see that her ears were already red.
"If Qingli is willing, I can do it at any time. If she is not willing, then I will pursue her until she is willing."
Yi Qingqing's voice was not loud, but very firm.
He remembered Leng Qingli's care for him. Who would refuse such a woman?
After a hundred thousand years, her feelings for him were still the same. How could there be no fluctuation in his heart?
He is not a ruthless person as his name suggests. On the contrary, he has a deeper attachment to love.
"Qingli, I hope you don't dislike this child." Yuyuan looked at Leng Qingli with a smile, her eyes full of love.
In her eyes, Leng Qingli was already her daughter-in-law. After Yi Qingqing left, Leng Qingli often came to talk to her and chat with her.
Leng Qingli treated her and Yizhencheng with great respect, even though her and Yizhencheng's identities were just the little masters of the Lingtian Sect.
When she and Yi Zhencheng passed away, Leng Qingli came to them at the last moment and brought their dissipating souls here.
The purpose is to make up for their regrets and see Yi Wuqing's last side.
"Aunt... Qingli is willing!" Leng Qingli said, her voice not as cold as before, but with a hint of shyness and nervousness.
"It's just...it's too late, you guys..." Leng Qingli's eyes dimmed.
"It's too late... Could it be..." Yi Qingqing looked at Yi Zhencheng and Yu Yuan, her eyes trembling slightly.
"Haha, isn't this normal? We are very satisfied to see the three of you again and to see you together." Yi Zhencheng smiled slightly, his smile was very free and easy.
"Yes, we are very satisfied. It's just a pity that we didn't get to see you get married and hold your grandson." Yu Yuan also laughed, her tone a bit regretful.
"Master, Master! Don't leave! I don't want to witness your departure again, I don't want to!" Yijue shouted at the top of her lungs with tears in her eyes.
"Jue'er, don't be sad...it's great to see you now." Yu Yuan smiled.
"Jue'er! Why are you crying again, and this time you are crying in front of Qingqing? How embarrassing." Yi Zhencheng said seriously: "I remember telling you when I was a child, you are an elder brother and you cannot show yourself like this in front of your junior brother!"
"Master...Master's wife...oh..." Yijue wiped her tears, but still couldn't control herself.
He has experienced too many life, separation and death, and every time he feels extremely reluctant to let go, but there is nothing he can do about it.
He couldn't stop his tears, nor could he control the sadness in his heart.
He didn't want to see his loved ones leave anymore. His heart was already riddled with holes and he didn't want to witness separation with his own eyes.
Farewell, such a hurtful word.
However, even if we are reluctant to leave, we will always leave.
Yi Qingqing looked at her parents' dissipating figures and stretched out her hand to hold them, but what she received instead was a gust of wind.
The breeze dissipated instantly in his hands.
"Father...Mother..." Yi Qingqing murmured softly, crying silently. He couldn't do anything, couldn't do anything.
"System...save them..." Yi Qingqing silently asked the system.
[Sorry host... there is nothing the system can do. 】
The system's voice was also very sad and helpless.
Yi Qingqing didn't say much. The system probably couldn't do anything about it, and he understood.
"Ruthless." Yi Zhencheng called softly.
